sum: The fund normally will invest at least 80% of its net assets in securities of small cap U.S. companies. It may purchase or sell futures contracts and options on futures contracts for U.S. equity securities and indices, to increase or decrease equity market exposure based on actual or expected cash inflows to or outflows from the Portfolio.

news.t: What US Small Cap Value Portfolio ETF (DFSV) Bought: Dick's Leads on Wednesday
